strings.en: 3. Are the P2S buildplate and the XPA series buildplates compatible?

The P2S buildplate's recognition function has been optimized. Older build plates do not support the type recognition feature, but their external dimensions are consistent, so they can still be used for printing.

You can purchase an official auxiliary cooling fan for upgrading.

strings.en: 5. Can the P2S use the nozzle of A1 and H2D?
It's compatible with H2D nozzles but not with A1 nozzles.

context.title: Bambu Lab P2S
context.near: 5. Can the P2S use the nozzle of A1 and H2D?

strings.en: 6. How many AMS units can the P2S connect to at most?
It supports connecting to 4 AMS 2 Pro units and 4 AMS HT units, totaling 8 AMS units with 20 slots. This means it supports up to 20-color printing.

context.title: Bambu Lab P2S
context.near: 6. How many AMS units can the P2S connect to at most?

strings.en: 7. Does the P2S support chamber temperature control, and how is the temperature controlled?
The P2S does not have an active chamber heating function, but it can regulate chamber temperature through its enclosed chamber and automatic switching flap between internal and external circulation.

strings.en: 8. Why did the P2S stop using carbon rods?
To allow for easier maintenance. Dirt residual is much simpler to clean off the surface of a smooth rod.
